title: should run pipe-bearing match_all query and return results
verifies: pipe inside match_all term is treated as literal — query runs without error and pipe is preserved in editor

title: should append filter to pipe-bearing query without corrupting the query
verifies: adding a filter from the index list appends 'and field=value' after the full pipe-bearing term instead of splitting at the pipe

title: should preserve multiple pipes verbatim in query editor
verifies: Monaco editor faithfully displays a query with multiple pipe characters exactly as typed

title: should run query with multiple pipes without error
verifies: a match_all term with several pipe characters runs successfully without error

title: should update editorValue correctly after adding filter to pipe-bearing query
verifies: editorValue mirrors the updated query with filter appended and pipe preserved after clicking a field value

title: should clear pipe-bearing query on reset filters
verifies: Reset Filters button clears a pipe-bearing query from the editor without being confused by the pipe

title: should treat pipe as literal character in SQL mode
verifies: pipe inside SQL str_match string is preserved and query executes without error in SQL mode
